title: Joining Data
description: Learn to combine data from multiple collections using Join and GroupJoin operators.
longDescription: This module covers the joining operators in LINQ. You'll learn to perform inner joins with Join and left outer joins with GroupJoin to combine data from multiple collections.
whatYouLearn: Combine data from two collections using Join
Perform inner joins with Join operator
Perform left outer joins with GroupJoin
Use the 'equals' keyword in query syntax
